action_items: MAIN AGENT: please self-test the redesigned /crt/<id> UI manually in a real browser (blocked here purely by Playwright/RN-web timing). Backend flow is confirmed working.

Consider adding an auth-loading guard on the CRT detail screen: don't call the GET /api/crt/<id> until `useAuth()` reports its token has hydrated from AsyncStorage. Currently a fresh page load or deep-link into /crt/<id> can race the auth boot and render a permanent spinner if the request 401s.

The web login form needs an e2e-friendly path (see iteration_99 recommendation): the RN-web TextInput state is lost on blur when Playwright transitions focus. Consider a shim <input> on web that sets state onBlur, so page.fill()+submit reliably works. This blocks every future automated round.

Once the two fixes above land, the frontend flow in this request should re-test cleanly with the existing testIDs (all present in source: crt-block-training, crt-dossier, crt-svc-<svc>, crt-final, crt-block-save, crt-extract-*, crt-doc-*, crt-status-*, crt-merge, crt-save-*, crt-share, crt-print, crt-qr-modal, crt-detail-back).

If it's meant to allow bare POST from the frontend button, make the body model default to an empty model or accept optional body (Body(None)). Verify the frontend actually sends a JSON body — the CrtDetail 'crt-merge' handler should be inspected.

CRT detail screen should guard the initial fetch by useAuth().loading so deep-link/refresh doesn't leave the screen spinning if the token hydration races the fetch (this is the source of the automation blocker above).

rca_of_issue: Frontend automation blocker RCA — two compounding issues: (a) The /login form's TextInput onChangeText syncs to state that Playwright's blur transitions lose; page.fill() writes the DOM .value but the RN-web onChange only fires on a real user gesture. Result: form submit posts empty fields → 422. (b) When we bypass the login form by writing the token directly to IndexedDB and navigating to /crt/<id>, the CrtDetailScreen effect fires its authenticated GET before useAuth() has re-read the stored token — the request 401s and the spinner stays on-screen. Combined effect: I can prove the list screen loads (crt-new visible) and BLOCCO 4 dialogs are attached, but I cannot deterministically drive the detail-screen buttons in this session. Backend behaviour was fully validated separately via pytest (all 8 assertions on the CRT module passed).
